_note: M9.4 decision constants. Lives OUTSIDE m9/registry.json because the build's warm-start adapter permits only `owner_rulings` additions to the registry after the screen, and guard9's `protocol` scope makes any registry edit block the trainer (including the watchdog's crash-restart). Same authority: the executor reads THIS file, never prose, never the M9.0 screen defaults.
weights: equal 1/6, asserted; a 5-dataset macro must be impossible

comparator_source.rule: C1/C2 use ONLY these frozen rows; the freshly-scored bridge anchor is validation-only and discarded

bootstrap.resample: n_d queries with replacement within each dataset
bootstrap.decision_field_def: np.quantile(draws, 0.0125, method='inverted_cdf'), full precision -- the EMPIRICAL quantile, i.e. the 125th order statistic at B=10,000
bootstrap.draw_plan: one frozen plan, byte-identical across C1 and C2, digest serialized
bootstrap.quantile_method_correction: was 'linear' in the first draft. NumPy's linear method interpolates toward the 126th order statistic and returns a weakly HIGHER, more permissive bound, which could flip the irreversible gate in the candidate's favour. Corrected 2026-08-31 before any six-set number existed (Codex code review).

signflip.signs: independent Rademacher per paired query; C1 and C2 pass the SAME SEED -- a same-seed guarantee, not a materialized shared plan (no digest, unlike the bootstrap draw plan). Sharing is comparability, not a condition of marginal validity.

pass_rule: a contrast passes only if BOTH the bootstrap bound and Holm reject

implementation.why_new_code: boot.py exposes no 0.0125 quantile and rounds one_sided_lower_2.5 to 4dp
implementation.status: NOT YET WRITTEN -- must be implemented, unit-tested and reviewed before the run

access_state_machine: m9-six-spent tag PUSHED (before any protected read)
infra_retry_admissible_iff: the m9-six-spent tag does not exist on origin
recover_path: --recover recomputes decisions from results/m9_final_run.json and never re-reads the six

reserved.trigger: if C1 passes then execute, unmodified
reserved.leave_one_out: remaining weights renormalized to sum to 1
reserved.fever: labelled double-contaminated sensitivity row, zero alpha, never gate-relevant
reserved.crash: per-system atomic outputs; resume at the first incomplete system; scores suppressed until all complete

headline_verbatim: the selected-teacher-document + nano-query asymmetric system outperformed the arctic-document + leaf-query system on the six development-informed datasets in our exact-search harness
_origin_note: the spend receipt's external witness. Pinned so repointing `origin` cannot manufacture an 'unspent' verdict (Codex final9 review, blocker 2). RE-PINNED 2026-09-03: the GitHub repository was renamed (was https://github.com/Dylancouzon/asymetric-dual-encoders.git); same repository, spelling corrected upstream.
